title: ExtraEnchantments
description: ExtraEnchants adds some new enchantments to the game!
body:
**This mod will no longer recieve updates.**

ExtraEnchants is a mod that adds new, useful enchantments.

## Current enchantment list:
- Toxicating
- Withering
- Lunar Aspect
- Healthy
- Swiftfooted
- Blazing Thorns
- Dashing
- Gold Digger
- Frosting
- Multi-Jump
## Enchantment Guide:
- Toxicating: 50% chance to apply poison to the enemy for 6 seconds per level. Max level is 2.
- Withering: 50% chance to apply wither to the enemy for 6 seconds per level. Max level is 2.
- Lunar Aspect: 33% chance to apply levitation to the enemy for 2 seconds. Max level is 1.
- Frosting. Freeze your enemy for 5 seconds per level. Max level is 2.
- Toxicating, Withering, Frosting, and Lunar Aspect are incompatible with each other and fire aspect. They each go on swords.
- Healthy: Grants the player 2 extra hearts. Goes on chestplates, max level is 1.
- Swiftfooted: Grants the player +10% movement speed per level. Goes on boots. Max level is 2
- Blazing Thorns: Ignites attackers for 5 seconds. Goes on pants. Max level is 1. Incompatible with thorns.
- Dashing: Lets you press a keybind to do a small dash. Goes on pants. Max level is 1. Incompatible with Blazing Thorns.
- Gold Digger: 8% chance to get a gold nugget from digging dirt. 5% chance that you will get an ingot instead. Goes on shovels.
- Multi-Jump: Lets you jump 1 more time midair per level. 2 levels. goes on boots.
